_doc: LOINC code per canonical lab item of data/lab_synonyms.json, for FHIR export (fhir_export.py).
loinc: LOINC code or null (not mapped - see note). display: LOINC long common name (LOINC 2.82).
ucum: UCUM code for the item's canonical unit in data/lab_synonyms.json (null = none / not asserted).
confidence: high | medium (null when unmapped). See data/loinc_map.README.md.
Interoperability demo mapping - must be reviewed before any clinical use.
source: LOINC 2.82; every code verified ACTIVE via HL7 tx.fhir.org CodeSystem/$lookup and NLM Clinical Tables LOINC search (loinc.org pages are bot-protected); verified 2026-09-30.

body_fat_pct.display: Percentage of body fat by Bioelectrical impedance analysis
body_fat_pct.note: Health-check body fat % comes from a bioelectrical-impedance (BIA) scale; use 41982-0 (Percentage of body fat Measured) if another method (e.g. DXA) was used.

waist.display: Waist Circumference at umbilicus by Tape measure
waist.note: LOINC's tape-measure waist term is defined at the umbilicus; Taiwan HPA protocol measures midway between the lowest rib and the iliac crest. Same property/unit, measurement site differs.

pulse.note: FHIR vital-signs heart-rate code; resting pulse counted at the health check. UCUM /min as required by the FHIR vital-signs profile.

sbp.note: Stand-alone systolic BP (the FHIR vital-signs profile alternatively groups SBP/DBP in panel 85354-9).

bone_mass.note: BIA-scale estimate of bone mineral mass (Tanita-style 'bone mass'); no matching LOINC term found.

metabolic_age.note: Proprietary body-composition-scale index; not a standard measurement, no LOINC term.

bmr.note: Device-estimated basal metabolic rate (kcal/day) from a BIA scale. LOINC only offers resting-metabolic-rate terms (e.g. 69429-9 'Metabolic rate --resting', kcal/kg/h) with a different definition/property; not mapped.

visceral_fat.note: Proprietary 1-59 rating on BIA scales. LOINC 73707-2 is visceral fat AREA (cm2, imaging) - a different property.

fat_right_arm.note: Segmental BIA fat %; no segment-specific LOINC term found.

fat_right_leg.note: Segmental BIA fat %; no segment-specific LOINC term found.

fat_left_arm.note: Segmental BIA fat %; no segment-specific LOINC term found.

fat_left_leg.note: Segmental BIA fat %; no segment-specific LOINC term found.

body_water.note: Devices report kg or % (LOINC 101683-1 'Body water mass' vs 101684-9 'Percentage of body water'); the catalog unit is blank so the property is unknown.

ideal_weight.note: Calculated target weight; the formula varies by provider (commonly BMI 22 x height^2).

muscle_mass.note: BIA scales derive muscle mass by calculation; 73964-9 is 'Body muscle mass Calculated'. Device algorithms differ.

wbc.display: Leukocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

rbc.display: Erythrocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

hct.display: Hematocrit [Volume Fraction] of Blood by Automated count

mcv.display: MCV [Entitic mean volume] in Red Blood Cells by Automated count

mchc.display: MCHC [Entitic Mass/volume] in Red Blood Cells by Automated count

plt.display: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

rdw.display: Erythrocyte [DistWidth] in Blood by Automated count
rdw.note: RDW-CV in % (catalog unit). RDW-SD in fL would be 21000-5.

mpv.display: Platelet [Entitic mean volume] in Blood by Automated count

pdw.note: Catalog unit is %, so the ratio term is used; analysers that report PDW in fL need 32207-3.

eos_pct.display: Eosinophils/Leukocytes in Blood by Automated count

baso_pct.display: Basophils/Leukocytes in Blood by Automated count

mono_pct.display: Monocytes/Leukocytes in Blood by Automated count

lymph_pct.display: Lymphocytes/Leukocytes in Blood by Automated count

neut_pct.display: Neutrophils/Leukocytes in Blood by Automated count

lymph_abs.display: Lymphocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

mono_abs.display: Monocytes [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

eos_abs.display: Eosinophils [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

baso_abs.display: Basophils [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

neut_abs.display: Neutrophils [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count

globulin.note: Globulin is reported as total protein minus albumin (calculated).

ast.display: Aspartate aminotransferase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

alt.display: Alanine aminotransferase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

alp.display: Alkaline phosphatase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

ggt.display: Gamma glutamyl transferase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

amylase.display: Amylase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

ag_ratio.display: Albumin/Globulin [Mass Ratio] in Serum or Plasma

bun.display: Urea nitrogen [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

egfr.display: Glomerular filtration rate [Volume Rate/Area] in Serum, Plasma or Blood by Creatinine-based formula (MDRD)/1.73 sq M
egfr.note: Reports rarely name the equation. Many Taiwanese reports use the (simplified) MDRD equation; the older MDRD code 33914-3 is DISCOURAGED in LOINC 2.82, so active 77147-7 is used. Use 62238-1 (CKD-EPI) or 98979-8 (CKD-EPI 2021) when the lab states CKD-EPI.

hdl.display: Cholesterol in HDL [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

ldl.display: Cholesterol in LDL [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma
ldl.note: Method-neutral LDL-C term. Reports rarely say whether LDL-C was measured directly (18262-6) or calculated by Friedewald (13457-7) and both occur in Taiwanese health checks, so the method-less code is used instead of guessing.

chol_hdl_ratio.display: Cholesterol.total/Cholesterol in HDL [Mass Ratio] in Serum or Plasma

ldl_hdl_ratio.display: Cholesterol in LDL/Cholesterol in HDL [Mass Ratio] in Serum or Plasma

risk_factor.note: '動脈硬化指數' is defined differently by different labs (TC/HDL, LDL/HDL or (TC-HDL)/HDL); the catalog entry itself says HDL/LDL. Not mapped; use chol_hdl_ratio / ldl_hdl_ratio when the definition is known.

glucose_ac.display: Fasting glucose [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

cea.display: Carcinoembryonic Ag [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

ca199.display: Cancer Ag 19-9 [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma
ca199.note: Reports print U/mL; these are arbitrary units, hence UCUM [arb'U]/mL (LOINC example unit).

ca125.display: Cancer Ag 125 [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

ca153.display: Cancer Ag 15-3 [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

psa.display: Prostate specific Ag [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

ebv_iga.note: Taiwanese NPC screening uses EBV VCA-IgA and/or EBNA1-IgA with titre, index or qualitative results depending on the kit; LOINC terms are antigen- and scale-specific (e.g. 22290-1 VCA IgA titer, 31369-2 VCA IgA units/volume), so no single code is safe.

cyfra.note: CYFRA 21-1 measures cytokeratin 19 fragments; LOINC lists 'Cyfra 21-1' as a related name of 25390-6.

nse.display: Enolase.neuron specific [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

hs_crp.display: C reactive protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by High sensitivity method
hs_crp.note: High-sensitivity CRP. LOINC example unit is mg/L; mass/volume property, so the catalog's mg/dL is valid.

crp.display: C reactive protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

insulin.note: Serum insulin; drawn fasting at health checks (fasting state is not part of this code).

homa_ir.note: LOINC 47214-2 'Homeostasis model assessment' does not distinguish HOMA-IR from HOMA-%B; health checks report HOMA-IR (from fasting glucose x insulin).

hbsag.display: Hepatitis B virus surface Ag [Presence] in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay
hbsag.note: Qualitative (Presence) immunoassay term. Reports print the cut-off index (COI, <1 = non-reactive) of that qualitative assay. Quantitative HBsAg in IU/mL would be 63557-3.

anti_hbs.display: Hepatitis B virus surface Ab [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay

hbeag.display: Hepatitis B virus e Ag [Presence] in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay
hbeag.note: Qualitative (Presence) immunoassay term; a printed COI/index of the same assay is carried under it.

anti_hcv.display: Hepatitis C virus Ab [Presence] in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay
anti_hcv.note: Qualitative (Presence) immunoassay term; reports print the cut-off index (COI) of that assay.

rf.display: Rheumatoid factor [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

hpv_rlu.note: Hybrid-Capture signal ratio (RLU/cutoff); no LOINC term for the HC2 signal ratio found. The qualitative HC2 result would be 30167-1.

hpv_result.note: Qualitative high-risk HPV DNA result; LOINC terms are assay-specific (30167-1 HC2, 13 types; 82675-0 NAA, 14 types incl. HPV 66) and the report does not identify the assay.

hpv_highrisk.note: Free-text list of detected high-risk genotypes; no single LOINC term.

h_pylori_ubt.display: Helicobacter pylori [Presence] in Stomach by urea breath test
h_pylori_ubt.note: Qualitative urea-breath-test result. The numeric (DOB, per mil) term 29892-7 is DISCOURAGED in LOINC 2.82.

fat_trunk.note: Segmental (trunk) BIA fat %; no segment-specific LOINC term found.

h_pylori_clo.note: Rapid urease test on gastric biopsy; LOINC lists 'CLO test; Clotest; Helicobacter pylori biopsy test' as related names.

fobt.display: Hemoglobin [Mass/volume] in Stool from gastrointestinal lower by Immunoassay
fobt.note: Quantitative faecal immunochemical test (Taiwan national program cut-off 100 ng/mL buffer). Qualitative-only reports (陰性/陽性) correspond to 29771-3.

free_t3.display: Triiodothyronine (T3) Free [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

free_t4.display: Thyroxine (T4) free [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tsh.note: TSH; uIU/mL is numerically equal to the LOINC example unit mIU/L.

amh.display: Mullerian inhibiting substance [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma
amh.note: Anti-Mullerian hormone (Mullerian inhibiting substance), mass concentration.

beta_hcg.display: Choriogonadotropin.beta subunit [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma
beta_hcg.note: Reports label the test beta-hCG; many assays actually measure total hCG (19080-1). Chosen per the report label.

na.note: Sodium; mEq/L = mmol/L for a monovalent ion.

ldh.display: Lactate dehydrogenase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma by Lactate to pyruvate reaction
ldh.note: The method-less LDH term 2532-0 is DISCOURAGED in LOINC 2.82; the IFCC lactate-to-pyruvate reaction is the usual method on current analysers. Use 14805-6 for pyruvate-to-lactate methods.

cpk.display: Creatine kinase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

urine_ph.display: pH of Urine by Test strip

urine_sg.display: Specific gravity of Urine by Test strip

urobilinogen.note: Catalog unit EU/dL matches 32727-0 (Units/volume, method not stated). Dipstick-specific terms are 20405-7 (mg/dL) and 5818-0 (presence).

urine_protein.display: Protein [Presence] in Urine by Test strip
urine_protein.note: Health-check dipstick protein is reported ordinally (-/+-/1+..4+); numeric mg/dL readings correspond to 5804-0.

urine_glucose.display: Glucose [Presence] in Urine by Test strip
urine_glucose.note: Dipstick glucose reported ordinally; numeric mg/dL readings correspond to 5792-7.

urine_bil.display: Bilirubin.total [Presence] in Urine by Test strip

urine_ketone.display: Ketones [Presence] in Urine by Test strip
urine_ketone.note: Dipstick ketones reported ordinally; numeric mg/dL readings correspond to 5797-6.

urine_nitrite.display: Nitrite [Presence] in Urine by Test strip

urine_ob.display: Hemoglobin [Presence] in Urine by Test strip

urine_le.display: Leukocyte esterase [Presence] in Urine by Test strip

urine_wbc.display: Leukocyte esterase [Presence] in Urine by Test strip
urine_wbc.note: The dipstick 'WBC' pad detects leukocyte esterase, so this shares 5799-2 with urine_le.

urine_rbc_sed.display: Erythrocytes [#/area] in Urine sediment by Microscopy high power field
urine_rbc_sed.note: Sediment microscopy, RBC per high-power field.

urine_wbc_sed.display: Leukocytes [#/area] in Urine sediment by Microscopy high power field
urine_wbc_sed.note: Sediment microscopy, WBC per high-power field.

urine_epi_sed.note: Reports do not specify squamous vs non-squamous or the method, so the generic 'Epithelial cells [#/area] in Urine sediment' term is used.

urine_crystal_sed.note: LOINC crystal terms are type-specific (calcium oxalate, urate, ...); the 'unidentified crystals' terms (e.g. 40482-2) mean something else. Not mapped.

urine_cast_sed.display: Casts [#/area] in Urine sediment by Microscopy low power field
urine_cast_sed.note: Sediment microscopy, casts per low-power field.

bmd.note: Health-check BMD is usually a calcaneal ultrasound (QUS) T-score; the LOINC T-score terms found are DXA- and site-specific (e.g. 38266-3 DXA Calcaneus) - a different method.

va_naked_right.note: Taiwanese reports use decimal acuity (e.g. 0.8); the LOINC term is a length ratio without chart/distance, so no UCUM unit is asserted.

va_corr_right.note: '矯正視力' is presenting acuity with the examinee's own glasses; LOINC only has 'best corrected' terms (65893-0 / 65897-1), which imply refraction.

va_corr_left.note: See va_corr_right (LOINC best-corrected term 65897-1 would overstate the method).

cvd_10y_risk.note: Taiwanese reports use local risk models (e.g. 10-year ischaemic-heart-disease probability); LOINC risk terms are model-specific (Framingham, SCORE, ACC/AHA PCE) or generic (99055-6) with an outcome definition that may not match.

framingham_score.note: Framingham point total (not a probability); LOINC Framingham terms are model-specific 10-year risk values.
